title: 808 Truth Horse Protocol
style: memphis phonk with legal-comms severity, 138 bpm, 808 sub heavy, distorted cowbell, courtroom gavel sample on the downbeat, deadpan male spoken word delivery, deterministic snare on the receipt, 336 hz subharmonic anchor, dark documenting mood, paper-trail texture
lyrics:
[Intro — gavel single hit, 808 drops]
(spoken) Truth on the record. Horse on the protocol.
Eight-oh-eight in the bass. Three-three-six in the receipt.

[Verse 1]
Every email timestamp, every screenshot frame
Hash on the receipt, hash on the name
No he-said she-said when the ledger does the talking
No he-said she-said when the file does the walking

[Pre-Drop]
What I said is what I said, what they said is what they said
The transcript is the witness, the witness has no head

[Drop]
808 — truth — horse — protocol
What the document says is the document's call
808 — truth — horse — protocol
Three-three-six in the chain, the chain holds it all

[Verse 2]
No screaming, no spinning, no wasted breath
Just the file, the date, the line, the depth
Legal lane is the calm lane, the slow steady stack
They can yell across the table, the receipt comes back

[Drop]
808 — truth — horse — protocol
What the document says is the document's call
808 — truth — horse — protocol
Three-three-six in the chain, the chain holds it all

[Outro]
Receipt. Receipt. Receipt.
Three-three-six on the seal.
